independent_answer: 192 sq ft if all four sides extend outward by 2 ft; 144 sq ft if only the two width boundaries extend.
check: The original length is 96 ÷ 8 = 12 ft. Extending all four sides gives (12 + 4)(8 + 4) = 192 sq ft; extending only the width gives 12(8 + 4) = 144 sq ft.
evidence_quote: The new length is 12 ft, and the new width is 12 ft.
error_description: The solution correctly computes the width-only interpretation, but “2 feet on each side” can also mean extending all four sides, which increases the length too.
